title: Property Charge Advance Repayment: Choice of Arrangement and Installment Terms at Agreement Issue
content:
## 1. Clause

1.1 The Property Charge Advance Repayment arrangement is chosen by the product's term selection rule: the installment plan whose arrearage band (from the band minimum to the band maximum, where a maximum of 0.00 means no limit) covers the arrearage balance on the issue date, unless the borrower elects a shorter plan, which the product permits; the borrower may instead repay in full under the Lump-Sum Repayment.

1.2 The At-Risk Extension is offered instead only when the youngest borrower is at least the product's at-risk minimum age and one of the qualifying critical circumstances is documented by the required at-risk evidence; it carries no installments.

1.3 An agreement is issued only when the borrower chooses an arrangement no later than the notice period, 30 calendar days, after the arrangement record opened. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the opened date, and a choice made on the last counted day still qualifies. The opened date is read from the arrangement record.

1.4 The monthly installment is the arrearage balance divided by the plan's term, rounded up to the cent, with the final installment adjusted to the remaining arrearage; the first installment falls due on the plan's installment due day of the month after the agreement is signed.

1.5 No installment arrangement is offered for 24 months after an earlier arrangement on the loan was referred for an uncured default.

1.6 Installments are paid only under arrangements whose terms require installments, and are rounded as the product's rounding term provides; a hardship review, where the product provides one and supported by the required hardship evidence, may move the borrower to another offered plan.

## 2. Notice-period boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Record opened | Day 1 of the count | Day 30 (last counted day) | Choice made on | Agreement may be issued |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 2 June | 1 July | 1 July | Yes |
| 1 June | 2 June | 1 July | 2 July | No |

## 3. Installment worked through (hypothetical figures)

An arrearage balance of 5000.00 on the issue date falls in the band 3000.01 to 6000.00, so the installment plan assigned is Repayment Plan - 24 Months. 5000.00 divided by 24 is 208.333…, rounded up to the cent: 208.34. Twenty-three installments of 208.34 total 4791.82, so the final installment is the remaining 208.18. Had the same borrower elected the shorter Repayment Plan - 12 Months, 5000.00 divided by 12 is 416.666…, rounded up to 416.67; eleven installments total 4583.37 and the final installment is 416.63.

## 4. Points of judgement

- The arrearage that selects the band is the balance on the issue date of the agreement.
- A shorter plan is the borrower's election; the band-assigned plan is never lengthened by election.
- The At-Risk Extension needs both the age and a documented circumstance.
- The 24-month bar concerns installment arrangements after an earlier arrangement on the same loan was referred for an uncured default.
